decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered out several accessories that were not standalone speakers (cables, cases, and battery bases). For my consideration set, I prioritized products with strong brand reputation and high ratings. The JBL Charge 5 and Sony SRS-XB43 represent the top-tier performance options, while the JBL Go 3 offers brand-name quality in a smaller form factor. The NOTABRICK and HyperGear speakers were included for their high value-to-performance ratio. I ultimately chose the JBL Charge 5 because its 4.8 rating over 16,000+ reviews is an industry-leading indicator of reliability and sound quality, which justifies the premium price for a long-term audio solution.
